entities.summary: Aleksey Yuryevich Russkikh, is a Russian statesman and politician who is currently the Governor of the Ulyanovsk Oblast since 8 April 2021. He is a member of the Communist Party. Alexei Russkikh was a political leaders from Izhevsk (b. 1968-07-17, Izhevsk). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to political systems and geopolitics.
